text_block_list.text:
During the New Year's holiday. While 
taking a leisurely stroll through town――
(Roll roll roll...)
choice_data_list: (Is this... cup ramen?)

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! The bag ripped open—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, oh no, Trainer-kun!?
choice_data_list: Out shopping for dinner?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, oh no, Trainer-chan!?
choice_data_list: Out shopping for dinner?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! I don't just eat instant food all 
the time, I cook for myself properly 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...No, even if I try to hide it, it's 
totally obvious. That I'm slacking off, I 
mean."
choice_data_list: No, no, some days are just like that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Really...? But lately, I've been living 
such a sloppy lifestyle...

Maruzensky says so, but speaking of how 
she spent the New Year's holidays—

Appearing as a representative of the 
Umamusume on a stage to give thanks for a 
year of support.

Invited to a New Year's special TV 
program, she was busy supporting her 
juniors and more—

As someone who leads the Umamusume, she 
has always maintained a dignified 
presence. That is precisely why—
choice_data_list:
When that happens, just lean on me and let 
me help you!

When that happens, please lean on me and 
let me help you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: To Trainer-kun? But...
choice_data_list: Supporting you is a trainer's job!
Backing you up is a Trainer's duty!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "To Trainer-chan? But..."
choice_data_list: Supporting you is a trainer's job!
Backing you up is a Trainer's duty!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That's... true, yes. Still, being 
spoiled... relying on someone..."

Maruzensky always works hard to be the 
reliable big sister. I know full well that 
she's not good at letting others pamper 
her.
choice_data_list:
Then let's test it out and let her pamper 
you today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's so good... Home-cooked food truly has 
the taste of pure happiness.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my stomach, tired from instant food, 
is rejoicing! As thanks, I'll do the 
dishes—
choice_data_list: They've got your favorite dessert too!
We even have your favorite dessert!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
! N-Nata de coco...! ...B-But... is it 
really okay for you to do all this for me?
choice_data_list: Of course! That's what I prepared it for.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look at this chain of misunderstandings! A 
trendy drama just wouldn't be complete 
without it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think I'd get to spend time with 
you like this.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think I could spend time like 
this with you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Dramas aren't for everyone, right? 
That's why I hesitated to invite you 
before, but—"
choice_data_list: Watching it together is fun, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm glad I gathered the courage to 
ask.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks so much for today! Thanks to you, 
I'm completely back on my feet!"
choice_data_list:
Whenever things get tough, you can always 
lean on me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Geez... What am I gonna do if you say 
things like that and make me totally 
dependent on you spoiled-style?
choice_data_list: Your energy gives me energy, after all.
Your energy is my energy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, just one last thing. May I be a 
little selfish?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I just want to soak in this moment a 
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...How is it, I wonder?
choice_data_list:
Then let's wrap it up in style with a 
night view!

Then wanna go to the public bath or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Look. Every single one of those lights is 
someone's cherished story."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Just kidding! Hehe, I've always wanted to 
say that line at least once♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I hope our story can shine as brilliantly 
as that someday...

As Maruzensky murmured with a smile, I 
agreed with her, saying, "Yeah, you're 
right."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, it's pretty crowded even at this 
hour!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, everyone looks like they're having 
fun. I'm so glad I got to come to a place 
like this with you♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone looks so happy. I'm so glad 
I could come to a place like this with 
you♪

For a little while, we leisurely enjoyed 
the lively night.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you know? This observatory was 
used as a filming location for "100 
Umamusume Winter Stories"!
choice_data_list: Uh, um...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, judging by that reaction, you haven't 
watched it, have you? Jeez, you absolutely 
have to watch it! I suuuuper recommend it!

I ended up listening to a passionate 
discussion about trendy dramas for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great! That way, all we have 
to do is go home and sleep.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!! A spacious bath after so long was 
just the best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I even got to enjoy some fruit milk after 
the bath. Post-bath traditions really are 
important!"

I took a leisurely trip back home with a 
high-spirited Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring might be nice for my next day 
off. Gotta treat myself, after all♪

Seeing that she had finally learned how to 
relax brought a sense of relief.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, I might've gotten a little flushed. 
Gotta keep the relaxation in moderation, 
huh?

Letting the heat cool down, we walked 
slowly through the nighttime streets.
